name: GP prediction-error model
description: Empirical SGP4 prediction error by orbit regime and prediction age, in RTN. Element sets are propagated to later element sets of the same object (consecutive-set differences, which are not truth) or to independent reference states (GCRF, from analysis/reference-states). Batches accumulate counts, moments and histograms; finalize gives mean, covariance, quantiles, robust sigma and clipped covariance per stratum. With a model on accumulate (reference mode), each error is also tested against its stratum's model covariance (Mahalanobis d^2 against chi-square with 3 degrees of freedom, every sample counted) and finalize gates each stratum CALIBRATED, FAILED or INSUFFICIENT; scale_model fits per-stratum scale factors to reference-state errors. screening_evaluation scores a probabilistic (Foster Pc), a bounded-set and a possibility (admissible-set) screening rule on independent cases built from reference-state errors with synthetic true misses. screening_cases scores the same rules on caller-supplied pairs, each object with its own covariance. common_epoch propagates element sets of one object to common epochs and returns each one's RTN difference from an origin there (a reference state, their mean, or one set). map_covariance maps an RTN covariance through a state transition matrix: SGP4's (central differences in nonsingular mean elements), two-body (complex-step Kepler) or the Lambert arc of Thompson et al. (2019). hpop_arcs and hpop_coverage calibrate HPOP covariance (P0 at the element-set epoch, white-acceleration process noise) against reference states. pair_statistics, fit_calibration, calibrate_covariance and dcp_covariance (orbit-accuracy-experiments E14) give the error and Mahalanobis statistics of predicted against truth states, fit covariance calibration factors per stratum, apply a frozen covariance model (operator-file factors by regime and horizon, or an element-set model by regime and age) to objects in RTN and inertial axes, and form the density-forecast consider covariance (an open Dynamic Consider Parameter). fit_elements fits SGP4 mean elements (an OMM, optionally B*) to an ephemeris by weighted Levenberg-Marquardt differential correction in equinoctial elements, with exact residual statistics on every state, a half-split closure test and the fit covariance; element_residuals scores element sets against an ephemeris over time windows.

sequentialJustification.detail: Deterministic SGP4 propagation and statistics over caller-supplied element sets and reference states. No host calls, threads or network access; batches are combined through the prior accumulator.
